description: PM OS hooks. Every event runs the Amp plugin modules in system/amp-plugins through hooks/amp-bridge.ts (Bun). Kill switch: ~/.claude/pm-os-plugin-config.json {"pm-os-bridge.disabled": true} or per plugin {"pm-os-guardrails.disabled": true}. SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit also run hooks/surface-context.py, which injects the dispatch card into CoS and Launchpad sessions (kill switch {"surface-context.disabled": true}); on a session's first prompt of start of day, CoS, or chief of staff in a cmux or wmux pane it also registers that tab as CoS through system/scripts/cos_autobind.py (kill switch {"cos-autobind.disabled": true}). Notification (permission_prompt, elicitation_dialog) runs system/scripts/permission_relay.py notify, which sends a worker or owner tab's waiting prompt to the live CoS (kill switch {"permission-relay.disabled": true}). The blocking PreToolUse bridge step has a 10 s timeout (normal runs take about 0.2 s; a timed-out hook lets the tool run, so a hang costs at most 10 s). PreToolUse (every tool), UserPromptSubmit, and Stop also run hooks/cmux-heartbeat.py, which resends the PreToolUse that cmux 0.65.2 drops so the sidebar ⚡ stays lit on a working Claude tab (kill switch {"cmux-heartbeat.disabled": true}). PreToolUse on mcp__claude-in-chrome__* also runs hooks/claude-in-chrome-guard.py (system/scripts/claude_in_chrome_guard.py), which logs each Claude in Chrome call to .state/claude-in-chrome.jsonl and refuses scheduled jobs, workers with no signed-in brief line, bank and email hosts the owner did not name, browser-internal pages, and cookie or storage scripts (fails closed). PreToolUse and UserPromptSubmit also run hooks/worker-closed.py, which denies non-read-only tools in a worker tab whose task row is already terminal (no live row took the tab over, and the owner has not typed there since), so a finished worker cannot act on a late message (kill switch {"worker-closed.disabled": true}).
